senses.gloss: pr. n. f.(b. h. צִפֹּרָה)Zipporah (Bird), wife of Moses.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:19">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 12:1">Num. XII, 1</cite>) <he>וכי כושית שמה והלא צ׳ וכ׳</he> was her name Kushith? Was not Z. her name? &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>נקרא שמה צ׳ … כציפור</he> she was named Zipporah (bird), because she sped like a bird (to bring Moses to her father’s house); a. e.
